name: Viral Storytelling Short

voiceover.tone: urgent but not fake, punchy, story-first
delivery_notes: preserve a rest beat after dense hooks

visual_language.motion: medium-to-high; effects return on important statements, not every word
visual_language.typography: bold readable social text with one impact phrase
visual_language.captions: one- or two-word chunks only when they improve pace
visual_language.color: high contrast with controlled accent color

preferred_sources: generated concept plates for non-evidence scenes
asset_strategy.generated_visual_policy: Allowed for metaphors and pattern interrupts; factual claims still need sources.

sound.sfx: whooshes, hits, ticks, reverses, risers used only on real visual events
sound.mix_rule: SFX land within 1-2 frames of visible motion and stay below voice

qc: first five seconds contain a clear supported claim or question
visual density drops when the hook is overloaded
SFX sync to actual rendered motion
